plan.notes: Source: University of Toledo 2025-2026 Graduate Catalog, 'Graduate Certificate in Bioinformatics and Biomarkers' (official catalog page). 'NOTES: The above Plan of Study grid is only an example.' Any THREE of the five listed courses complete the certificate, except only one of BIPG 6400 / BRIM 6200 may count (content overlap); choice made with the program director. Second Term is therefore a catalog-defined choice slot. BMSP 6340 Current Problems & Research Approaches in Genes and Genomes (or approved equivalent) is required for ADMISSION to the program, not part of the 9-credit plan.

courses.title: Bioinformatics/Biomarker elective (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one: BIPG 6100 Bioinformatic Computation; BIPG 6400 Applications of Bioinformatics (odd years); BRIM 6200 Biomarker Discovery, Validation and Implementation (even years). Only one of BIPG 6400 / BRIM 6200 may count toward the certificate.
